_README: Per-visual-domain pass thresholds (fraction of items that must be correct).
These are REGRESSION GUARDS, not claims about the model's ability. The bar

They differ per domain on purpose: chart and diagram reasoning is materially
harder than reading rendered text, so holding every bucket to one flat bar
would make the suite either trivially green or permanently red -- in both
cases useless as a regression signal.
Values here override the DEFAULT_THRESHOLDS dict in check.py. Recalibrate
only against several runs, using the per-run accuracy spread reported by
variance_report.py -- never against a single run.
